## README

# AgentLite — Agent Orchestration Platform on Vercel

Agent orchestration platform providing health checks, agent lifecycle management, task queuing, and real-time monitoring capabilities.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Frontend Dashboard (Next.js)            │
│  - Real-time agent status monitoring     │
│  - Task management UI                    │
│  - Metrics visualization                 │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                 │
┌────────────────▼────────────────────────┐
│  Next.js API Routes (/api/*)             │
│  - Agents (CRUD)                         │
│  - Tasks (queue, process, status)        │
│  - Metrics & Logs                        │
│  - Health & Ecosystem status             │
│  - Cron jobs (process-results)           │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                 │
┌────────────────▼────────────────────────┐
│  Supabase Backend (PostgreSQL)           │
│  - agents, tasks, execution_logs         │
│  - agent_states, performance_metrics     │
│  - safari_command_queue (daemon events)  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- npm or yarn
- Supabase project (free tier works)

### Local Development

```bash
# Clone and install dependencies
git clone <repo>
cd agentlite
npm install

# Create .env.local with Supabase credentials
cat > .env.local << EOF
SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=your-service-role-key
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
CRON_SECRET=your-secret-here
EOF

# Start development server
npm run dev
# Open http://localhost:3000
```

### Environment Variables

Required:
- `SUPABASE_URL` - Supabase project URL
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` - Service role key (for server-side operations)

Optional:
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` - Public Supabase URL
- `CRON_SECRET` - Secret for cron job authentication
- `API_KEY` - Default API key for endpoints
- `JWT_SECRET` - JWT signing secret

## API Endpoints

### Health & Status
- `GET /api/health` - Service health check with Supabase connectivity
- `GET /api/ecosystem` - Full ecosystem snapshot from Supabase

### Agents (CRUD)
- `POST /api/agents` - Create agent
- `GET /api/agents` - List agents (with pagination & filtering)
- `GET /api/agents/:id` - Get agent details
- `PUT /api/agents/:id` - Update agent
- `DELETE /api/agents/:id` - Delete agent (hard or soft delete)

### Tasks (Queue)
- `POST /api/tasks` - Create and enqueue task
- `GET /api/tasks` - List tasks (with stats)
- `GET /api/tasks/:id` - Get task status and results
- `PUT /api/tasks/:id` - Update task status or retry
- `DELETE /api/tasks/:id` - Cancel task

### Monitoring
- `GET /api/metrics` - Query performance metrics
- `GET /api/recent` - Recent booking results

### Cron Jobs (Vercel)
- `POST /api/cron/orchestrate` - 15-minute decision loop
- `POST /api/cron/process-results` - 5-minute result processor

## Authentication

API endpoints support multiple auth methods:

```bash
# API Key
curl -H "x-api-key: your-api-key" http://localhost:3000/api/agents

# Bearer Token (JWT)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer token" http://localhost:3000/api/agents
```

## Database Schema

### Core Tables
- `agents` - Agent registry with status and config
- `tasks` - Task queue with priority and retry logic
- `execution_logs` - Audit trail of all executions
- `agent_states` - State persistence for recovery
- `performance_metrics` - Time-series metrics

### External Integration
- `safari_command_queue` - Daemon command results
- `agent_bookings` - Scheduled actions from decision engine

## Deployment

### Deploy to Vercel

```bash
# Install Vercel CLI (if not already installed)
npm i -g vercel

# Deploy
vercel --prod

# Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard
# Settings > Environment Variables
```
